name: lookup_patient
description: MUST call as soon as the caller provides their full name. A full name alone is sufficient; never ask the caller to provide a phone number. Bolna may include from_number silently when real inbound caller ID is available. If multiple records are returned, ask who the appointment is for and call again with the complete name; never guess.

full_name.description: Complete caller/patient name. This is sufficient for lookup; do not collect a phone number.

from_number.description: Inbound caller ID from Bolna context {from_number}.
